propertyTaxRate.note: Derived from statute, not a survey figure: 11 GCA 24103(a) levies 7/72% (0.0972%) on land value and 7/18% (0.3889%) on improvements, and 24102(f) defines value as 90% of appraised value. A home whose appraisal is roughly 30% land / 70% improvements yields 0.9 x (0.3 x 0.000972 + 0.7 x 0.003889) = 0.0027, so 0.0028 is consistent; a pure-improvement bound is 0.0035. Improvements of $1,000,000+ carry an extra 7/18% (24103(b)).

programs.name: Veteran Exemption

ratingRequired.quote: Real property owned and occupied as a residence by a person who is rated by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (USDVA) as one hundred percent (100%) disabled or individually unemployable due to injuries received while on duty with the Armed Forces of the United States ... is hereby exempted from all property taxes

survivingSpouse.quote: surviving spouse, as defined in § 67101(e) of Chapter 67, Title 10 GCA, and legal guardian, as defined in § 67101(g) of Chapter 67, Title 10 GCA, is hereby exempted from all property taxes; provided: ... the surviving spouse is not remarried
survivingSpouse.note: Resolves the brief's lead. Gold Star spouses and parents have a separate full exemption at 11 GCA 24401.2.

statute cite.correct: 11 GCA § 24401.1 (added by P.L. 34-106:1, June 5, 2018); 10 GCA § 67101 only supplies the surviving-spouse and legal-guardian definitions

sources.title: 11 GCA Chapter 24 Real Property Tax (Guam Compiler of Laws, COL 2026-05-05): 24102(f), 24103, 24401.1, 24401.2
Guam DRT Real Property Tax Division: Application for Veteran Exemption (100% disabled/IU, surviving spouse, Gold Star)

summary: Guam's full exemption for veterans rated 100% or IU is confirmed at 11 GCA 24401.1 (P.L. 34-106, 2018) and expressly covers the unremarried surviving spouse and legal guardian, so survivingSpouse should be true and the details' '10-3-67101' cite corrected. The 0.28% rate is consistent with the statutory 7/72% land and 7/18% improvement levies on 90% of appraised value; the Gold Star exemption (24401.2) is survivor-only and missing.
